description: The roles this merchant has defined and exactly what each one is allowed to do — Settings → Roles. Answers 'what can a cashier do', 'which roles exist', 'who is on the Manager role'. A role is the ONLY place permissions live: people do not carry their own. Read this before changing anything, and take permission ids from the granted list when revoking. Owners and organisation-level accounts hold no role and are never restricted by one — a role change cannot take anything away from them.
name: hub_get_roles
title: List roles
